title: Older BAE archives colleague with TS/SCI warned him
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Older BAE archives colleague with TS/SCI warned him, about BAE employment at BAE, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of the older guys who uh worked for archives had a TSSCI and made his way to the intelligence community as a government employee.

plain: Dylan Borland, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that when he worked at BAE, a large defence company, an older colleague in the archives warned him about something. Borland says this man held a TS/SCI clearance, one of the highest levels of US security clearance, and later moved into the intelligence community as a government employee, which is why Borland treats the warning as coming from someone who would know.
